entries.sanskrit:
दशमे शिव आगत्य मुनेस् तुष्टो वरान् अदात् ।

तेन साकम् अति-प्रीत्या समाभाष्य सभाजयन् ॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

स एवम् अनुभूयेदं नारायण-विनिर्मितम् ।  
वैभवं योग-मायायास् तम् एव शरणं ययौ ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

sa evam anubhūyedaṃ nārāyaṇa-vinirmitam |
vaibhavaṃ yoga-māyāyās tam eva śaraṇaṃ yayau ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: The Supreme Lord Nārāyaṇa had arranged this opulent display of His bewildering potency. Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi, having experienced it, took shelter of the Lord.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
श्री-मार्कण्डेय उवाच—

प्रपन्नोऽस्म्य् अङ्घ्रि-मूलं ते प्रपन्नाभय-दं हरे ।  
यन्-माययापि विबुधा मुह्यन्ति ज्ञान-काशया ॥
entries.transliteration:
śrī-mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—

prapanno’smy aṅghri-mūlaṃ te prapannābhaya-daṃ hare |
yan-māyayāpi vibudhā muhyanti jñāna-kāśayā ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: श्री-नारायण एव स्व-माया-दर्शन-श्रान्तं शिव-रूपेण सान्त्वयाम् आस, तद् आह—तम् एवम् इत्य्-आदिना । निभृतात्मानं समादित-चित्तम् । रुद्राण्या भवान्या ॥३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

तम् एवं निभृतात्मानं वृषेण दिवि पर्यटन् ।  
रुद्राण्या भगवान् रुद्रो ददर्श स्व-गणैर् वृतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

tam evaṃ nibhṛtātmānaṃ vṛṣeṇa divi paryaṭan |
rudrāṇyā bhagavān rudro dadarśa sva-gaṇair vṛtaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Lord Rudra, traveling in the sky on his bull and accompanied by his consort, Rudrāṇī, as well as his personal associates, observed Mārkaṇḍeya in trance.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
अथोमा तम् ऋषिं वीक्ष्य गिरिशं समभाषत ।  
पश्येमं भगवन् विप्रं निभृतात्मेन्द्रियाशयम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
athomā tam ṛṣiṃ vīkṣya giriśaṃ samabhāṣata |
paśyemaṃ bhagavan vipraṃ nibhṛtātmendriyāśayam ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: निभृतं निश्चल-भक्तिम् इति ॥५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
निभृतोद-झष-व्रातो वातापाये यथार्णवः ।  
कुर्व् अस्य तपसः साक्षात् संसिद्धिं सिद्धि-दो भवान् ॥
entries.transliteration:
nibhṛtoda-jhaṣa-vrāto vātāpāye yathārṇavaḥ |
kurv asya tapasaḥ sākṣāt saṃsiddhiṃ siddhi-do bhavān ||
entries.literal_english: He is as calm as the waters of the ocean when the wind has ceased and the fish remain still. Therefore, my lord, since you bestow perfection on the performers of austerity, please award this sage the perfection that is obviously due him.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: आशिषो ऽभ्युदय-लक्षणाः । उत निश्चितम् । अत्र हेतुः, भक्तिम् इति ॥६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
श्री-भगवान् उवाच—

नैवेच्छत्य् आशिषः क्वापि ब्रह्मर्षिर् मोक्षम् अप्य् उत ।  
भक्तिं परां भगवति लब्धवान् पुरुषेऽव्यये ॥
entries.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—

naivecchaty āśiṣaḥ kvāpi brahmarṣir mokṣam apy uta |
bhaktiṃ parāṃ bhagavati labdhavān puruṣe’vyaye ||
entries.literal_english: Lord Śiva replied: Surely this saintly brāhmaṇa does not desire any benediction, not even liberation itself, for he has attained pure devotional service unto the inexhaustible Personality of Godhead.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: संवदिष्यामः संवदं करिष्यामः ॥७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अथापि संवदिष्यामो भवान्य् एतेन साधुना ।  
अयं हि परमो लाभो नृणां साधु-समागमः ॥
entries.transliteration:
athāpi saṃvadiṣyāmo bhavāny etena sādhunā |
ayaṃ hi paramo lābho nṛṇāṃ sādhu-samāgamaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Still, my dear Bhavānī, let us talk with this saintly personality. After all, association with saintly devotees is man’s highest achievement.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: सतां गतित्वे हेतुः, ईशान् इति ॥८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

इत्य् उक्त्वा तम् उपेयाय भगवान् स सतां गतिः ।  
ईशानः सर्व-विद्यानाम् ईश्वरः सर्व-देहिनाम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

ity uktvā tam upeyāya bhagavān sa satāṃ gatiḥ |
īśānaḥ sarva-vidyānām īśvaraḥ sarva-dehinām ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Having spoken thus, Lord Śaṅkara — the shelter of pure souls, master of all spiritual sciences and controller of all embodied living beings — approached the sage.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: रुद्धा धियोऽन्तः-करणस्य वृत्तयो येन सः ॥९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तयोर् आगमनं साक्षाद् ईशयोर् जगद्-आत्मनोः ।  
न वेद रुद्ध-धी-वृत्तिर् आत्मानं विश्वम् एव च ॥
entries.transliteration:
tayor āgamanaṃ sākṣād īśayor jagad-ātmanoḥ |
na veda ruddha-dhī-vṛttir ātmānaṃ viśvam eva ca ||
entries.literal_english: Because Mārkaṇḍeya’s material mind had stopped functioning, the sage failed to notice that Lord Śiva and his wife, the controllers of the universe, had personally come to see him. Mārkaṇḍeya was so absorbed in meditation that he was unaware of either himself or the external world.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
भगवांस् तद् अभिज्ञाय गिरिशो योग-मायया ।  
आविशत् तद्-गुहाकाशं वायुश् छिद्रम् इवेश्वरः ॥
entries.transliteration:
bhagavāṃs tad abhijñāya giriśo yoga-māyayā |
āviśat tad-guhākāśaṃ vāyuś chidram iveśvaraḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
आत्मन्य् अपि शिवं प्राप्तं तडित्-पिङ्ग-जटा-धरम् ।  
त्र्य्-अक्षं दश-भुजं प्रांशुम् उद्यन्तम् इव भास्करम् ॥

व्याघ्र-चर्माम्बर-धरं शूल-धनुर्-इष्व्-असि-चर्मभिः ।  
अक्ष-माला-डमरुक- कपालं परशुं सह ॥

बिभ्राणं सहसा भातं विचक्ष्य हृदि विस्मितः ।  
किम् इदं कुत एवेति समाधेर् विरतो मुनिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
ātmany api śivaṃ prāptaṃ taḍit-piṅga-jaṭā-dharam |
try-akṣaṃ daśa-bhujaṃ prāṃśum udyantam iva bhāskaram ||

vyāghra-carmāmbara-dharaṃ śūla-dhanur-iṣv-asi-carmabhiḥ |
akṣa-mālā-ḍamaruka- kapālaṃ paraśuṃ saha ||

bibhrāṇaṃ sahasā bhātaṃ vicakṣya hṛdi vismitaḥ |
kim idaṃ kuta eveti samādher virato muniḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
नेत्रे उन्मील्य ददृशे स-गणं सोमयागतम् ।  
रुद्रं त्रि-लोकैक-गुरुं ननाम शिरसा मुनिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
netre unmīlya dadṛśe sa-gaṇaṃ somayāgatam |
rudraṃ tri-lokaika-guruṃ nanāma śirasā muniḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: सोमया उमया सहागतं रुद्रं ददृशे । ततो ननाम ॥१४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तस्मै सपर्यां व्यदधात् स-गणाय सहोमया ।  
स्वागतासन-पाद्यार्घ्य- गन्ध-स्रग्-धूप-दीपकैः ॥
entries.transliteration:
tasmai saparyāṃ vyadadhāt sa-gaṇāya sahomayā |
svāgatāsana-pādyārghya- gandha-srag-dhūpa-dīpakaiḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Mārkaṇḍeya worshiped Lord Śiva, along with Umā and Śiva’s associates, by offering them words of welcome, sitting places, water for washing their feet, scented drinking water, fragrant oils, flower garlands and ārati lamps.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: पूर्ण-कामत्वं व्यनक्ति, येन त्वया जगन्-निर्वृतं भवतीति ॥१६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
आह त्व् आत्मानुभावेन पूर्ण-कामस्य ते विभो ।  
करवाम किम् ईशान येनेदं निर्वृतं जगत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
āha tv ātmānubhāvena pūrṇa-kāmasya te vibho |
karavāma kim īśāna yenedaṃ nirvṛtaṃ jagat ||
entries.literal_english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: O mighty lord, what can I possibly do for you, who are fully satisfied by your own ecstasy? Indeed, by your mercy you satisfy this entire world.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: निर्गुणत्वेन त्रि-गुणत्वेन च नमस्-करोति, नमः शिवाय निर्गुणाय । सत्त्वाय सत्त्वाधिष्ठात्रे । अत एव प्रमृडयति सुखयतीति तथा तस्मै ॥१७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सत्त्वाय प्रमृडाय च ।  
रजो-जुषोऽपि घोराय नमस् तुभ्यं तमो-जुषे ॥
entries.transliteration:
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sattvāya pramṛḍāya ca |
rajo-juṣo’pi ghorāya namas tubhyaṃ tamo-juṣe ||
entries.literal_english: Again and again I offer my obeisances unto you, O all-auspicious transcendental personality. As the lord of goodness you give pleasure, in contact with the mode of passion you appear most fearful, and you also associate with the mode of ignorance.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

एवं स्तुतः स भगवान् आदि-देवः सतां गतिः ।  
परितुष्टः प्रसन्नात्मा प्रहसंस् तम् अभाषत ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān ādi-devaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ |
parituṣṭaḥ prasannātmā prahasaṃs tam abhāṣata ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: नोऽस्मत्तः त्रयो ब्रह्म-विष्णु-महेश्वराः । यद् येभ्यः । ते वयम् ॥१९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
श्री-भगवान् उवाच—

वरं वृणीष्व नः कामं वर-देशा वयं त्रयः ।  
अमोघं दर्शनं येषां मर्त्यो यद् विन्दतेऽमृतम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—

varaṃ vṛṇīṣva naḥ kāmaṃ vara-deśā vayaṃ trayaḥ |
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ yeṣāṃ martyo yad vindate’mṛtam ||
entries.literal_english: Lord Śiva said: Please ask me for some benediction, since among all givers of benedictions, we three — Brahmā, Viṣṇu and I — are the best. Seeing us never goes in vain, because simply by seeing us a mortal achieves immortality.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: वर-दानादिना भवत्-सेवैवास्माभिः क्रियते—न त्व् अनुग्रहो जगद्-वन्द्यत्वाद् भवताम् इति ब्राह्मणान् स्तौति—ब्राह्मणा इत्य्-आदि । ये साधवः सद्-आचाराः । शान्ता मत्सरादि-रहिताः । निःसङ्गा निष्कामाः ॥२०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणाः साधवः शान्ता निःसङ्गा भूत-वत्सलाः ।  
एकान्त-भक्ता अस्मासु निर्वैराः सम-दर्शिनः ॥
entries.transliteration:
brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaḥ śāntā niḥsaṅgā bhūta-vatsalāḥ |
ekānta-bhaktā asmāsu nirvairāḥ sama-darśinaḥ ||
word_for_word: peaceful and free of envy and other bad qualities
of ourselves (Brahmā, Lord Śrī Hari and Śiva)
entries.literal_english: The inhabitants and ruling demigods of all planets, along with Lord Brahmā, the Supreme Lord Hari and I, glorify, worship and assist those brāhmaṇas who are saintly, always peaceful, free of material attachment, compassionate to all living beings, purely devoted to us, devoid of hatred and endowed with equal vision.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न केवलं त एव, किन्त्व् अहं चेत्य्-आदि ॥२१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
स-लोका लोक-पालास् तान् वन्दन्त्य् अर्चन्त्य् उपासते ।  
अहं च भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयं च हरिर् ईश्वरः ॥
entries.transliteration:
sa-lokā loka-pālās tān vandanty arcanty upāsate |
ahaṃ ca bhagavān brahmā svayaṃ ca harir īśvaraḥ ||
entries.literal_english: The inhabitants and ruling demigods of all planets, along with Lord Brahmā, the Supreme Lord Hari and I, glorify, worship and assist those brāhmaṇas who are saintly, always peaceful, free of material attachment, compassionate to all living beings, purely devoted to us, devoid of hatred and endowed with equal vision.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: पूज्यतमत्वे हेत्व्-अन्तरम् आह—नेति । अण्व् अप्य् अणु-मात्रम् अपि । न चक्षते न पश्यन्ति । तत् तस्माद् एवं-भूतान् युष्मान् ईमहि भजेम ॥२२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
न ते मय्य् अच्युतेऽजे च भिदाम् अण्व् अपि चक्षते ।  
नात्मनश् च जनस्यापि तद् युष्मान् वयम् ईमहि ॥
entries.transliteration:
na te mayy acyute’je ca bhidām aṇv api cakṣate |
nātmanaś ca janasyāpi tad yuṣmān vayam īmahi ||
entries.literal_english: These devotees do not differentiate between Lord Viṣṇu, Lord Brahmā and me, nor do they differentiate between themselves and other living beings. Therefore, because you are this kind of saintly devotee, we worship you.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
न ह्य् अम्-मयानि तीर्थानि न देवाश् चेतनोज्झिताः ।  
ते पुनन्त्य् उरु-कालेन यूयं दर्शन-मात्रतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
na hy am-mayāni tīrthāni na devāś cetanojjhitāḥ |
te punanty uru-kālena yūyaṃ darśana-mātrataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ब्राह्मणान् । आत्म-समाधानं चित्तैकाग्र्यम् । तप आलोचनम् । स्वाध्यायोऽध्ययनम् । संयमो वाग्-आदि-नियमस् तैः ॥२४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्यामो येऽस्मद्-रूपं त्रयी-मयम् ।  
बिभ्रत्य् आत्म-समाधान- तपः-स्वाध्याय-संयमैः ॥
entries.transliteration:
brāhmaṇebhyo namasyāmo ye’smad-rūpaṃ trayī-mayam |
bibhraty ātma-samādhāna- tapaḥ-svādhyāya-saṃyamaiḥ ||
word_for_word: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्यामो येऽस्मद्-रूपं त्रयी-मयम् ।   बिभ्रत्य् आत्म-समाधान- तपः-स्वाध्याय-संयमैः ॥

By meditating upon the Supreme Soul, performing austerities, engaging in Vedic study and following regulative principles, the brāhmaṇas sustain within themselves the three Vedas, which are nondifferent from Lord Viṣṇu, Lord Brahmā and me. Therefore I offer my obeisances unto the brāhmaṇas.
entries.literal_english: By meditating upon the Supreme Soul, performing austerities, engaging in Vedic study and following regulative principles, the brāhmaṇas sustain within themselves the three Vedas, which are nondifferent from Lord Viṣṇu, Lord Brahmā and me. Therefore I offer my obeisances unto the brāhmaṇas.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit:
किं च, श्रवणाद् इत्य्-आदि ॥२५॥

[^६०]:
    अत्रानुरूपार्थकं भा। १.१९.३३श-पद्यं द्रष्टव्यम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
श्रवणाद् दर्शनाद् वापि महा-पातकिनोऽपि वः ।  
शुध्येरन्न् अन्त्यजाश् चापि किम् उ सम्भाषणादिभिः ॥
entries.transliteration:
śravaṇād darśanād vāpi mahā-pātakino’pi vaḥ |
śudhyerann antyajāś cāpi kim u sambhāṣaṇādibhiḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Even the worst sinners and social outcastes are purified just by hearing about or seeing personalities like you. Imagine, then, how purified they become by directly speaking with you.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: चन्द्रो ललामो भूषणं यस्य तस्य धर्म-रहस्य-युक्तम् अमृतास्पदं वचः कर्णाभ्यां पिबन्न् आतृप्यद् अलम् इति नामन्यत । कर्णयोर् अमृतायनम् इति वान्वयः ॥२६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

इति चन्द्र-ललामस्य धर्म-गुह्योपबृंहितम् ।  
वचोऽमृतायनम् ऋषिर् नातृप्यत् कर्णयोः पिबन् ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

iti candra-lalāmasya dharma-guhyopabṛṃhitam |
vaco’mṛtāyanam ṛṣir nātṛpyat karṇayoḥ piban ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Drinking with his ears Lord Śiva’s nectarean words, full of the confidential essence of religion, Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi could not be satiated.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: शिवस्य वाग् एवामृतं तेन ध्वस्तः क्लेश-पुञ्जो यस्य सः ॥२७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
स चिरं मायया विष्णोर् भ्रामितः कर्शितो भृशम् ।  
शिव-वाग्-अमृत-ध्वस्त- क्लेश-पुञ्जस् तम् अब्रवीत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
sa ciraṃ māyayā viṣṇor bhrāmitaḥ karśito bhṛśam |
śiva-vāg-amṛta-dhvasta- kleśa-puñjas tam abravīt ||
entries.literal_english: Mārkaṇḍeya, having been forced by Lord Viṣṇu’s illusory energy to wander about for a long time in the water of dissolution, had become extremely exhausted. But Lord Śiva’s words of nectar vanquished his accumulated suffering. Thus he addressed Lord Śiva.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: इयं लीला दुर्विभाव्यावितर्क्या । यद् यया ईशितव्यानि स्व-नियम्यानि यानि भूतानि तानि जगद्-ईश्वराः । स्वयं नमन्ति स्तुवन्ति चेति ॥२८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
श्री-मार्कण्डेय उवाच—

अहो ईश्वर-लीलेयं दुर्विभाव्या शरीरिणाम् ।  
यन् नमन्तीशितव्यानि स्तुवन्ति जगद्-ईश्वराः ॥
entries.transliteration:
śrī-mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—

aho īśvara-līleyaṃ durvibhāvyā śarīriṇām |
yan namantīśitavyāni stuvanti jagad-īśvarāḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: It is indeed most difficult for embodied souls to understand the pastimes of the universal controllers, for such lords bow down to and offer praise to the very living beings they rule.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: अथवा लोक-सङ्ग्रह-मात्रम् एतद् इत्य् आह—धर्मम् इति । प्रवक्तारोऽपि यत् स्वयं देहिनां धर्मं ग्राहयितुम् आचरन्ति ॥२९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
धर्मं ग्राहयितुं प्रायः प्रवक्तारश् च देहिनाम् ।  
आचरन्त्य् अनुमोदन्ते क्रियमाणं स्तुवन्ति च ॥
entries.transliteration:
dharmaṃ grāhayituṃ prāyaḥ pravaktāraś ca dehinām |
ācaranty anumodante kriyamāṇaṃ stuvanti ca ||
entries.literal_english: Generally it is to induce embodied souls to accept religious principles that the authorized teachers of religion exhibit ideal behavior while encouraging and praising the proper behavior of others.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: नन्व् एतत् स्व-प्रभाव-तिरस्कारकं कथं मया क्रियते ? तत्राह—नैतावतेति । एतवता लोक-सङ्ग्रह-मात्रेण । तैर् नमनादिभिः कथं-भूतैः ? स्व-माया-मयी वृत्तिर् येषु, तैर् भगवतो मायिनस् तवानुभावो न दुष्येत, यतः प्रसिद्धस्य मायिनः कुहकं कपटं यथा, तथा एतानि नमनादीनि । अतस् तस्य यथा कुहकैर् आत्मानुभावो न दुष्यति तद्वत् । प्रदुष्येतानुभाव इति पाठे न-कारस्य दृष्टान्तेऽप्य् अनुषङ्गः ॥३०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
नैतावता भगवतः स्व-माया-मय-वृत्तिभिः ।  
न दुष्येतानुभावस् तैर् मायिनः कुहकं यथा ॥
entries.transliteration:
naitāvatā bhagavataḥ sva-māyā-maya-vṛttibhiḥ |
na duṣyetānubhāvas tair māyinaḥ kuhakaṃ yathā ||
entries.literal_english: This apparent humility is simply a show of mercy. Such behavior of the Supreme Lord and His personal associates, which the Lord effects by His own bewildering potency, does not spoil His power any more than a magician’s powers are diminished by his exhibition of tricks.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: माया-चेष्टितं प्रपञ्चयति, सृष्ट्वेति । स्वप्न-दृग् यथेत्य् अविद्या चेष्टिते दृष्टान्तः । त्रि-गुणत्वेऽपि न जीव-वत् तद्-अभिभूताय किन्तु गुणानाम् आत्मने नियन्त्रे ॥३१-३२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सृष्ट्वेदं मनसा विश्वम् आत्मनानुप्रविश्य यः ।  
गुणैः कुर्वद्भिर् आभाति कर्तेव स्वप्न-दृग् यथा ॥

तस्मै नमो भगवते त्रि-गुणाय गुणात्मने ।  
केवलायाद्वितीयाय गुरवे ब्रह्म-मूर्तये ॥
entries.transliteration:
sṛṣṭvedaṃ manasā viśvam ātmanānupraviśya yaḥ |
guṇaiḥ kurvadbhir ābhāti karteva svapna-dṛg yathā ||

tasmai namo bhagavate tri-guṇāya guṇātmane |
kevalāyādvitīyāya gurave brahma-mūrtaye ||
word_for_word: by His mind, simply by His desire
unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead
entries.literal_english: I offer my obeisances to that Supreme Personality of Godhead, who has created this entire universe simply by His desire and then entered into it as the Supersoul. By making the modes of nature act, He seems to be the direct creator of this world, just as a dreamer seems to be acting within his dream. He is the owner and ultimate controller of the three modes of nature, yet He remains alone and pure, without any equal. He is the supreme spiritual master of all, the original personal form of the Absolute Truth. I offer my obeisances to that Supreme Personality of Godhead, who has created this entire universe simply by His desire and then entered into it as the Supersoul. By making the modes of nature act, He seems to be the direct creator of this world, just as a dreamer seems to be acting within his dream. He is the owner and ultimate controller of the three modes of nature, yet He remains alone and pure, without any equal. He is the supreme spiritual master of all, the original personal form of the Absolute Truth.

entries.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व इति । यद् उक्तं, तत्राह—कम् इति । वरं दर्शनं यस्य तस्मात् त्वत्तः परं कं नु वरं वृणे । यस्य तव दर्शनाद् अवलोकनात् पूर्ण-कामः सर्वानन्द-सन्दोह-रूपः सत्य-कामो यथेच्छं प्राप्त-सर्वानन्दः ॥३३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कं वृणे नु परं भूमन् वरं त्वद् वर-दर्शनात् ।  
यद्-दर्शनात् पूर्ण-कामः सत्य-कामः पुमान् भवेत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
kaṃ vṛṇe nu paraṃ bhūman varaṃ tvad vara-darśanāt |
yad-darśanāt pūrṇa-kāmaḥ satya-kāmaḥ pumān bhavet ||
entries.literal_english: O all-pervading lord, since I have received the benediction of seeing you, what other benediction can I ask for? Simply by seeing you, a person fulfills all his desires and can achieve anything imaginable.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
वरम् एकं वृणेऽथापि पूर्णात् कामाभिवर्षणात् ।  
भगवत्य् अच्युतां भक्तिं तत्-परेषु तथा त्वयि ॥
entries.transliteration:
varam ekaṃ vṛṇe’thāpi pūrṇāt kāmābhivarṣaṇāt |
bhagavaty acyutāṃ bhaktiṃ tat-pareṣu tathā tvayi ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: वर-दानाय स्वयम् एव प्रवृत्तः शर्वयोमया चाभिनन्दितोऽनुमोदितः सन्न् आह ॥३५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

इत्य् अर्चितोऽभिष्टुतश् च मुनिना सूक्तया गिरा ।  
तम् आह भगवाञ् छर्वः शर्वया चाभिनन्दितः ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

ity arcito’bhiṣṭutaś ca muninā sūktayā girā |
tam āha bhagavāñ charvaḥ śarvayā cābhinanditaḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Thus worshiped and glorified by the eloquent statements of the sage Mārkaṇḍeya, Lord Śarva \[Śiva\], encouraged by his consort, replied to him as follows.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: कामोऽयं सर्वोऽप्य् अन्यच् च यत् पुण्यं यश इत्य्-आदि-ब्रह्म-वर्चस्विनस् ते भूयाद् इत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः । यतस् त्वम् अधोक्षजे भक्तिमान् ॥३६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कामो महर्षे सर्वोऽयं भक्तिमांस् त्वम् अधोक्षजे ।  
आ-कल्पान्ताद् यशः पुण्यम् अजरामरता तथा ॥
entries.transliteration:
kāmo maharṣe sarvo’yaṃ bhaktimāṃs tvam adhokṣaje |
ā-kalpāntād yaśaḥ puṇyam ajarāmaratā tathā ||
word_for_word: for the transcendental Personality of Godhead
entries.literal_english: O great sage, because you are devoted to Lord Adhokṣaja, all your desires will be fulfilled. Until the very end of this creation cycle, you will enjoy pious fame and freedom from old age and death.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
ज्ञानं त्रैकालिकं ब्रह्मन् विज्ञानं च विरक्तिमत् ।  
ब्रह्म-वर्चस्विनो भूयात् पुराणाचार्यतास्तु ते ॥
entries.transliteration:
jñānaṃ traikālikaṃ brahman vijñānaṃ ca viraktimat |
brahma-varcasvino bhūyāt purāṇācāryatāstu te ||
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: तस्य कर्म तप-आदि । अमुना पुरानुभूतं यद् भगवन्-माया-वैभवं तच् च कथयन् ॥३८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सूत उवाच—

एवं वरान् स मुनये दत्त्वागात् त्र्य्-अक्ष ईश्वरः ।  
देव्यै तत्-कर्म कथयन्न् अनुभूतं पुरामुना ॥
entries.transliteration:
sūta uvāca—

evaṃ varān sa munaye dattvāgāt try-akṣa īśvaraḥ |
devyai tat-karma kathayann anubhūtaṃ purāmunā ||
entries.literal_english: Sūta Gosvāmī said: Having thus granted Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi benedictions, Lord Śiva went on his way, continuing to describe to goddess Devī the accomplishments of the sage and the direct exhibition of the Lord’s illusory power that he had experienced.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: अवाप्तो महा-योग-महिमा येन सः ॥३९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सोऽप्य् अवाप्त-महा-योग- महिमा भार्गवोत्तमः ।  
विचरत्य् अधुनाप्य् अद्धा हराव् एकान्ततां गतः ॥
entries.transliteration:
so’py avāpta-mahā-yoga- mahimā bhārgavottamaḥ |
vicaraty adhunāpy addhā harāv ekāntatāṃ gataḥ ||
entries.literal_english: Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi, the best of the descendants of Bhṛgu, is glorious because of his achievement of perfection in mystic yoga. Even today he travels about this world, fully absorbed in unalloyed devotion for the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: एतन् मार्कण्डेयस्य चरितं तेनानुभूतं च भगवन्-माया-वैभवं तेऽनुवर्णितम् ॥४०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अनुवर्णितम् एतत् ते मार्कण्डेयस्य धीमतः ।  
अनुभूतं भगवतो माया-वैभवम् अद्भुतम् ॥
entries.transliteration:
anuvarṇitam etat te mārkaṇḍeyasya dhīmataḥ |
anubhūtaṃ bhagavato māyā-vaibhavam adbhutam ||
entries.literal_english: I have thus narrated to you the activities of the highly intelligent sage Mārkaṇḍeya, especially how he experienced the amazing power of the Supreme Lord’s illusory energy.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: नन्व् एवम् अप्य् अस्मत् कुलोत्पन्नस्यास्य सप्त-कल्पायुष्ट्वं वृद्धैर् उच्यमानं विरुद्धम् एव तत्राह—एतन् मार्कण्डेयेनानुभूतं भगवन्-माया-वैभवं नाना-कल्प-रूपं कादाचित्कम् ईश्वरेच्छया तस्यैवाकस्मिकम्, न तु सर्व-साधारणम् । एतत् केचिद् अनादि-बहु-कालम् आवर्तितं दैव-युग-सहस्र-द्वयमानेन पुनः पुनः परिवर्तितं प्रचक्षते । के ते ? नॄणां संसृतिं सर्ग-प्रलयादि-लक्षणाम् आत्मनो भगवतो मायेत्य् एवम् अविद्वांसः । विद्वांसस् तु माया-शिशोः श्वासोच्छ्वासाभ्यां सप्त-कृत्वस् तद् उदर-प्रवेश-निर्गमतः सप्त-कल्पत्वं तत्-क्षण-मात्रेणेति वदन्ति, अतो न विरोध इत्य् अर्थः ॥४१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
एतत् केचिद् अविद्वांसो माया-संसृतिम् आत्मनः ।  
अनाद्य्-आवर्तितं नॄणां कादाचित्कं प्रचक्षते ॥
entries.transliteration:
etat kecid avidvāṃso māyā-saṃsṛtim ātmanaḥ |
anādy-āvartitaṃ nṝṇāṃ kādācitkaṃ pracakṣate ||
entries.literal_english: Although this event was unique and unprecedented, some unintelligent persons compare it to the cycle of illusory material existence the Supreme Lord has created for the conditioned souls — an endless cycle that has been continuing since time immemorial.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved.

entries.sanskrit: संशृणुयात् । उ इति हर्षे । संश्रावयेद् वा । यौ ताव् उभौ । तयोः कर्म-वासनाकृता संसृतिर् न भवेद् इति ॥४२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
य एवम् एतद् भृगु-वर्य वर्णितं

रथाङ्ग-पाणेर् अनुभाव-भावितम् ।

संश्रावयेत् संशृणुयाद् उ ताव् उभौ

तयोर् न कर्माशय-संसृतिर् भवेत् ॥
entries.transliteration:
ya evam etad bhṛgu-varya varṇitaṃ

rathāṅga-pāṇer anubhāva-bhāvitam |

saṃśrāvayet saṃśṛṇuyād u tāv ubhau

tayor na karmāśaya-saṃsṛtir bhavet ||
entries.literal_english: O best of the Bhṛgus, this account concerning Mārkaṇḍeya Ṛṣi conveys the transcendental potency of the Supreme Lord. Anyone who properly narrates or hears it will never again undergo material existence, which is based on the desire to perform fruitive activities.
